achievements.name: Moss Mother
achievements.detail: Defeat the Moss Mother in Moss Grotto.

achievements.name: Silkspear
achievements.detail: Bind the Silkspear at the weaver shrine in Mosshome.

achievements.name: Bell Beast
achievements.detail: Defeat the Bell Beast in the Marrow and open travel along the bellways.

achievements.name: Swift Step
achievements.detail: Bind Swift Step at the weaver shrine in Deep Docks.

achievements.name: Lace
achievements.detail: Win the first needle duel against Lace in Deep Docks.

achievements.name: Drifter's Cloak
achievements.detail: Finish the Seamstress's wish in the Far Fields and take the Drifter's Cloak.

achievements.name: Cling Grip
achievements.detail: Defeat Sister Splinter in Shellwood and bind the Cling Grip.

achievements.name: Widow
achievements.detail: Defeat Widow above Bellhart to gain the Needolin and restore the town.

achievements.name: Last Judge
achievements.detail: Defeat the Last Judge on the Blasted Steps and pass the Citadel gate.

achievements.name: Clawline
achievements.detail: Bind the Clawline at the shrine in the Cauldron.

achievements.name: Threefold Melody
achievements.detail: Learn the three melodies the Citadel requires and play them as one.

achievements.name: Grand Mother Silk
achievements.detail: Defeat Grand Mother Silk in the Cradle.

achievements.name: Last Path
achievements.detail: Finish the story path that continues after the Cradle.
